title_en: Yang Jun v. Dongtai Dongsheng Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. — dispute over commercial housing sales contract
ruling_gist_en: 1. The People's Court independently exercises the judicial power in accordance with the law, and in hearing cases, it takes facts as the basis and the law as the criterion. The factual basis upon which the People's Court determines a case refers to the objective facts ascertained through trial in accordance with the law. The approval documents of the construction administrative department and the quality compliance documents signed by units such as architectural engineering survey, design, construction, and project supervision respectively, are only litigation evidence in lawsuits concerning the quality of housing construction projects, and do not have inherent finality and binding force on the People's Court's determination of facts. If objective facts such as cracks and leakage in the house exist, and such objective facts are indeed caused by construction, then the People's Court shall determine that the house has quality defects in accordance with the law.

full_text_en:
**Yang Jun v. Dongtai Dongsheng Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. — Dispute over Commercial Housing Sales Contract**

**Ruling Summary**

1. When the People's Court independently exercises its judicial power in accordance with the law, it takes facts as the basis and the law as the criterion in adjudicating cases. The factual basis upon which the People's Court establishes its case refers to objective facts that have been verified through legal trial procedures. The approval documents from the construction administration department and the quality acceptance documents signed separately by entities such as the construction project survey, design, construction, and project supervision units are merely litigation evidence in lawsuits concerning the quality of building construction projects. They do not inherently possess definitive force or binding effect on the People's Court's determination of facts. If objective facts such as wall cracks, water leakage, etc., exist and these objective facts are indeed caused by construction work, then the People's Court shall legally determine that the building has quality defects.

2. Unless otherwise specifically agreed, the seller of a house shall guarantee that the quality of the house complies with the mandatory standards for construction projects and the terms of the contract. If a buyer of a house claims civil liability such as repair against the seller due to quality defects in the house, the People's Court shall uphold such a claim.

**Plaintiff:** Yang Jun, female, 34 years old, residing at Hailing South Road, Dongtai City, Jiangsu Province.

**Defendant:** Dongtai Dongsheng Real Estate Development Co., Ltd., domiciled at XinDong South Road, Dongtai City, Jiangsu Province.

**Legal Representative:** Ji Guodong, General Manager of the Company.

The Plaintiff, Yang Jun, filed a lawsuit with the Dongtai City People's Court of Jiangsu Province against the Defendant, Dongtai Dongsheng Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Dongsheng Real Estate Company), regarding a dispute over a commercial housing sales contract.

**Plaintiff's Allegations:** On March 25, 2006, the Plaintiff signed a commercial housing sales contract with the Defendant, Dongsheng Real Estate Company, purchasing one unit, Room A, Building 10, Shui Jing Wan, Dongtai City, developed by the Defendant. From May to September of the same year, the Plaintiff carried out fine decoration. During the decoration and habitation process, the Plaintiff discovered problems such as wall cracks and window leakage. Although the Defendant performed multiple repairs on the cracks and leakage after being notified, they failed to permanently fix the issues, thereby causing losses to the Plaintiff. Subsequently, Nanjing Southeast Construction Engineering Safety Appraisal Co., Ltd. conducted an appraisal on the cause of the cracks and leakage and proposed a repair plan, determining that the wall cracks were mainly caused by the uneven shrinkage of structural materials during temperature changes. The absence of a roof insulation layer and the poor quality of wall masonry led to obvious temperature cracks on the top floor, and the wall cracks were the direct cause of leakage around the windows. Therefore, the Plaintiff requested the Defendant to bear the civil liability for repairing the house cracks and related costs, and to compensate for the losses of RMB 7,100 caused by the cracks and leakage.

The Plaintiff, Yang Jun, submitted the following evidence:

1. One copy each of the commercial housing sales contract signed between the Plaintiff, Yang Jun, and the Defendant, Dongsheng Real Estate Company, the house ownership certificate, the residential use manual, and the residential quality guarantee certificate, to prove the existence of a sale and purchase relationship between the plaintiff and the defendant, and that the waterproofing works for the roof, waterproofing requirements for bathrooms and rooms, anti-leakage of exterior walls, foundation structure works, and main structure works all fall within the defendant's warranty scope.

2. Sixteen photographs and one copy of the Appraisal Report No. SF207078-1 from Nanjing Southeast Construction Engineering Safety Appraisal Co., Ltd., to prove that the house delivered by the Defendant, Dongsheng Real Estate Company, had quality defects of cracks and leakage, caused by the uneven shrinkage of structural materials during temperature changes. The absence of a roof insulation layer and poor wall masonry quality resulted in obvious temperature cracks on the top floor, which seriously affected the Plaintiff Yang Jun's use and aesthetic enjoyment of the house. The appraisal report also proposed correction and repair plans for the cracks.

3. One copy each of the construction quality supervision report issued by the Dongtai City Construction Project Quality Supervision Station and the supervision unit project quality evaluation report, to prove that the house delivered by the Defendant, Dongsheng Real Estate Company, had quality defects in building energy efficiency in terms of engineering design, which the defendant did not disclose in the contract and failed to inform the plaintiff upon delivery.

4. Explanations regarding the maintenance of Dongtai Shui Jing Wan dated August 13, 2007, and June 12, 2007, and the statement and suggestions on handling the quality issues reported by the owner, issued by the Defendant, Dongsheng Real Estate Company, to prove that the defendant had carried out repairs but failed to fix the problems.

5. A construction project budget statement dated December 30, 2007, to prove the project budget for the correction and repair plan proposed in the appraisal conclusion.

6. One copy each of the tax registration certificate, business license, decoration project contract, receipt, repair record sheet, situation report, and witness testimony of Nanjing Qiandu Decoration Engineering Co., Ltd., Dongtai Branch, to prove that during the decoration period of the Plaintiff, Yang Jun's house, due to the Defendant Dongsheng Real Estate Company's second repair of the walls of Room A, the decoration period was delayed, resulting in compensation to the decoration party of a total of RMB 7,100.

7. The "Appraisal Opinion on the Cost of Rectification and Repair for Room A, Building 10, Shui Jing Wan, Dongtai City" (Document No. Jian Su Ning Jia [2008] No. 213) issued by the Jiangsu Branch of China Construction Bank Corporation, to prove the costs required for the repair and rectification of the house.

**Defendant's Defense:** The Defendant argued that the house delivered to the Plaintiff, Yang Jun, had passed the completion acceptance inspection. The Defendant only bears the responsibility for repair within the warranty period in accordance with the contract and legal provisions. The Defendant's construction drawing design documents passed the review of relevant administrative departments and complied with national mandatory standards and specifications. The absence of a roof insulation layer was in accordance with design requirements and regulations, and it was not the Defendant's fault. The construction of a new or additional roof insulation layer is not a legal obligation of the Defendant. The Plaintiff's claims lack basis in contract or law, and therefore, the Defendant requested that the Plaintiff's claims be dismissed.

The Defendant, Dongsheng Real Estate Company, submitted the following evidence:

1. The survey unit quality evaluation report, design unit project quality inspection report, supervision unit project quality evaluation report, unit project completion acceptance report, unit project delivery and completion acceptance certificate, and construction quality supervision report, to prove that the house passed the acceptance inspections by various parties, including the government's project quality supervision department. The project was constructed according to the drawings, met the design requirements, was a quality-acceptable project, and complied with national mandatory standards and specifications.

2. The notice on the issuance of "Control Standards for Common Quality Defects in Residential Projects", the "Control Standards for Common Quality Defects in Residential Projects", and the "Handbook on Prevention Measures for Common Quality Defects in Residential Projects", to prove that wall masonry cracks and leakage are common quality defects in projects, and that building energy efficiency was only listed as a mandatory standard in April 2006.

3. Document No. 20041226, the construction drawing design review report, general description of design construction drawings, the design drawings for the Plaintiff Yang Jun's house, and the construction project earthquake resistance review certificate, to prove that the commercial house delivered by the Defendant, Dongsheng Real Estate Company, and its construction drawings complied with national mandatory specifications, passed the review of relevant administrative departments, and that the construction of the roof insulation layer was not the Defendant's legal obligation.

4. Document No. Dong Jian Fa [2006] No. 136 from the Dongtai City Planning and Construction Bureau, to prove that the mandatory standards and regulations for building energy efficiency in Jiangsu Province came into effect in Dongtai City on June 1, 2006, and that the house in question by the Plaintiff, Yang Jun, had no energy efficiency requirements when it was constructed.

**Facts Found by the Dongtai City People's Court at First Instance:**

On March 25, 2006, the Plaintiff, Yang Jun, signed a commercial housing sales contract with the Defendant, Dongsheng Real Estate Company. The contract stated that the Plaintiff purchased from the Defendant one unit, Room A, Building 10, Shui Jing Wan, located at the former XinDong South Road (now Hailing South Road), Dongtai City, developed by the Defendant. The house was for residential use, with a total price of RMB 441,430. The "Residential Quality Guarantee Certificate" was attached as an appendix to the contract. The seller shall, from the date of house delivery, bear corresponding warranty responsibilities according to the contents promised in the "Residential Quality Guarantee Certificate." For quality problems occurring within the warranty scope and warranty period of the house, the seller shall fulfill the warranty obligations. For damage caused by force majeure or reasons not attributable to the seller, the seller does not bear responsibility but may assist in repairs, with the repair costs borne by the purchaser. Building 10 of Shui Jing Wan is a stacked villa, having 4 structural floors excluding the top attic floor, of brick-concrete structure, with no insulation layer on the roof. The Defendant did not inform the Plaintiff of this when selling the house. The designer of the building was Tongzhou City Architectural Design Institute, the contractor was Tongzhou City Huajian Construction and Installation Engineering Company, and the supervisor was Tongzhou City Tianyuan Construction Supervision Consulting Co., Ltd. The building commenced construction on April 1, 2005, and was completed on January 20, 2006.

On June 21, 2006, the Plaintiff, Yang Jun, obtained the house ownership certificate for the property in question. During decoration and habitation, the Plaintiff discovered multiple wall cracks, window leakage, and other issues. The Plaintiff made several repair requests, and the Defendant, Dongsheng Real Estate Company, sent personnel to repair them multiple times, but failed to fix them permanently.

On September 3, 2007, the Plaintiff, Yang Jun, filed a lawsuit against the Defendant, Dongsheng Real Estate Company, in court, requesting the repair of the house's cracks. During the trial, the Plaintiff applied for an appraisal of the causes of the wall cracks and leakage and a repair plan. On December 11, 2007, Nanjing Southeast Construction Engineering Safety Appraisal Co., Ltd. issued the Appraisal Report No. SF207078-1 on the Causes and Repair Plan for Cracks in Room A, Building 10, Shui Jing Wan, Dongtai City (hereinafter referred to as the Appraisal Report). Its appraisal conclusion stated: The main cause of wall cracks in Room A, Building 10, Shui Jing Wan, was the uneven shrinkage of structural materials during temperature changes. The absence of a roof insulation layer and poor wall masonry quality led to obvious temperature cracks on the top floor. These cracks do not affect the safety of the main structure but severely impact aesthetics and functionality. The proposed correction and repair plan was: 1. Repair plan for existing cracks: For cracks penetrating both sides, structural adhesive can be used for crack injection. For cracks on the plaster layer, the original plaster layer can be removed and re-plastered. 2. Treatment plan to prevent further crack development: Since the cracks in Room A, Building 10, Shui Jing Wan, are essentially temperature cracks, they may become more pronounced when temperature differences are large. Although temperature cracks do not affect the safety performance of the main structure, they affect the building's appearance and use. Therefore, measures should be taken to reduce the damage caused by temperature changes to the building. Considering that the roof of Room A, Building 10, does not have an insulation layer, it is recommended to remove the original roof tiles and construct a new insulated roof according to drawing set Su J9801-1/8. The layers of the new insulated roof shall be as follows: (1) Original roof tiles; (2) 25mm thick 1:2.5 cement mortar mixed with 107 glue, internally laid with one layer of 16-gauge galvanized steel wire mesh; (3) 40mm thick extruded polystyrene insulation board; (4) One layer of 3mm thick polymer roll SBS; (5) 20mm thick 1:3 cement mortar leveling layer; (6) Cast-in-situ reinforced concrete roof slab.

On December 19, 2007, the Plaintiff, Yang Jun, filed a motion to withdraw the lawsuit. On the same day, the court issued Civil Ruling (2007) Dong Min Yi Chu Zi No. 1895, granting the Plaintiff's withdrawal. On December 21, 2007, the Plaintiff filed a new lawsuit requesting the Defendant, Dongsheng Real Estate Company, to bear civil liability for permanently repairing the house cracks and leakage and related costs, and to compensate for losses of RMB 7,100 caused by the cracks and leakage.

On January 7, 2008, the Plaintiff, Yang Jun, applied for an assessment of the cost of rectification and repair work for Room A, Building 10, Shui Jing Wan, Dongtai City. On July 9, 2008, the Jiangsu Branch of China Construction Bank Corporation issued the "Appraisal Opinion on the Cost of Rectification and Repair Engineering for Room A, Building 10, Shui Jing Wan, Dongtai City" (Document No. Jian Su Ning Jia [2008] No. 213), concluding that the cost of rectification and repair engineering for the Plaintiff's house located at Room A, Building 10, Shui Jing Wan, Dongtai City, was RMB 35,481.36.

**Issues in Dispute at First Instance:**

1. Whether the house sold by the Defendant, Dongsheng Real Estate Company, to the Plaintiff, Yang Jun, had quality defects;
2. If quality defects existed, whether the Defendant should bear civil liability;
3. If the Defendant should bear civil liability, what form of civil liability should be borne.

**Opinion of the Dongtai City People's Court at First Instance:**

First, the house sold by the Defendant, Dongsheng Real Estate Company, to the Plaintiff, Yang Jun, had quality defects.
1. According to Articles 60 and 62 of the Construction Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the Construction Law), the roof and walls of a completed construction project must not have quality defects such as leakage or cracking, and a quality warranty system applies to construction projects. The Construction Law and the State Council's "Regulations on the Quality Management of Construction Projects" (hereinafter referred to as the Quality Management Regulations) do not provide further interpretation or provisions on "quality defects." Article 3 of the Ministry of Construction's "Measures for the Quality Warranty of Housing Construction Projects" states: "For the purposes of these Measures, 'quality warranty of housing construction projects' means the repair of quality defects that appear within the warranty period after the completion acceptance of a housing construction project. For the purposes of these Measures, 'quality defect' means that the quality of a housing construction project does not meet the mandatory standards for construction projects or the terms of the contract." By reference to this provision, as long as the quality of a housing construction project does not meet legal standards or the purpose of the contract, a quality defect can be deemed to exist.
2. According to Article 52 of the Construction Law, the quality of survey, design, and construction of construction projects must meet the requirements of national mandatory standards for construction project safety, with specific management measures to be formulated by the State Council. According to Articles 3 and 16 of the Quality Management Regulations, the construction unit, survey unit, design unit, construction unit, and project supervision unit are each responsible for the quality of the construction project in accordance with the law. After receiving the completion report of the construction project, the construction unit shall organize relevant units responsible for the quality of the construction project to conduct a completion acceptance. Only after the survey, design, construction, project supervision, and other units have respectively signed quality acceptance documents can the project be delivered for use. In a lawsuit filed by a party regarding the quality of a housing construction project, the approval documents from relevant administrative departments and the quality acceptance documents from units such as survey, design, construction, and project supervision, provided by the construction unit, can only be used as evidence and do not inherently possess definitive force or binding effect on the People's Court's determination of facts.
3. In this case, the house purchased by the Plaintiff had problems such as cracks and leakage, which is an objective fact. Moreover, this objective fact was confirmed by the judicial appraisal conclusion to be caused by the uneven shrinkage of structural materials during temperature changes. The design defect of the roof and the poor quality of wall masonry led to obvious temperature cracks on the top floor. Considering the above three points comprehensively, it is sufficient to determine that the house sold by the Defendant to the Plaintiff in this case had quality defects. The Defendant's argument that the house quality should be deemed acceptable because the construction design documents were reviewed and approved by relevant administrative departments and the house passed the acceptance inspections by relevant units after completion is not adopted.

Second, the Defendant, Dongsheng Real Estate Company, should bear corresponding civil liability for the quality defects of the house in this case.
1. As mentioned above, China implements a quality warranty system for construction projects. According to Article 40 of the Quality Management Regulations, under normal use conditions, the warranty period for the main structure of a house is the reasonable service life of the project specified in the design documents. The warranty period for leak-proof works for rooms and external walls is 5 years. The warranty period is calculated from the date of acceptance of the completed project. According to the judicial appraisal conclusion, although the main structure of the disputed house in this case does not have safety issues, there are quality defects of cracks and leakage. The Plaintiff, Yang Jun, claimed her rights within the warranty period, and her claim should be upheld.
2. According to Article 2 of the Product Quality Law of the People's Republic of China, that law does not apply to construction projects. Therefore, the liability for quality defects of the house claimed by the Plaintiff should be governed by the provisions of construction laws and regulations and the general provisions of civil law. Articles 58 and 60 of the Construction Law establish the general principle that the construction unit is responsible for the construction quality of the construction project. Article 41 of the Quality Management Regulations stipulates: "If a quality problem occurs within the warranty scope and warranty period of a construction project, the construction unit shall fulfill the warranty obligation and bear liability for compensation for the losses caused." The above provisions of construction laws and regulations aim to clarify that the ultimate liable party for the quality of construction projects is the construction unit. According to Article 155 of the Contract Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the Contract Law), if the subject matter delivered by the seller does not meet the quality requirements, the buyer may request the seller to bear corresponding liability for breach of contract. Therefore, the Plaintiff's claim against the Defendant has a legal basis.
3. In this case, the quality defects in the house delivered by the Defendant to the Plaintiff were relatively hidden. According to the appraisal, the causes of the quality defects existed at the time of delivery of the house, but were only discovered after delivery. In the "Residential Quality Guarantee Certificate" signed by both parties, it was also agreed that if quality problems occur within the warranty scope and warranty period of the house, the seller shall fulfill the warranty obligations. Considering the above three points comprehensively, the Plaintiff has the right to claim that the Defendant bear corresponding civil liability.

Third, the Defendant, Dongsheng Real Estate Company, should bear the repair liability for the quality defects of the house.
According to Article 111 of the Contract Law, if the quality does not conform to the agreement, the buyer may reasonably choose to request the other party to bear liabilities for breach of contract such as repair, replacement, rework, return of goods, reduction of price or remuneration, etc. Article 13 of the Supreme People's Court's Interpretation on Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Disputes over Commercial Housing Sales Contracts states: "If the quality problems of a house seriously affect normal habitation and use, and the buyer requests rescission of the contract or compensation for losses, the People's Court shall support such a request. If a delivered house has quality problems, within the warranty period, the seller shall bear the repair liability. If the seller refuses to repair or delays repair within a reasonable period, the buyer may repair or entrust others to repair the house. The repair costs and other losses caused during the repair period shall be borne by the seller." In this case, the house delivered by the Defendant to the Plaintiff, Yang Jun, had quality problems of cracks and leakage that seriously affected habitation and use. The Plaintiff chose to request the Defendant to bear the civil liability for permanently repairing the cracks and leakage of the house. This request should be upheld according to law. The Defendant shall perform the repair obligations in accordance with the correction and repair plan specified in the Appraisal Report No. SF207078-1 issued by Nanjing Southeast Construction Engineering Safety Appraisal Co., Ltd. Regarding the Plaintiff's claim for the costs related to the permanent repair of the house cracks and leakage, as these costs have not yet been actually incurred, the court does not uphold this claim. Regarding the Plaintiff's claim for compensation of RMB 7,100 for losses caused by the cracks and leakage, the evidence is insufficient, and the court does not uphold this claim.

Accordingly, the Dongtai City People's Court of Jiangsu Province, pursuant to Articles 2 and 63 of the Supreme People's Court's Provisions on Evidence in Civil Proceedings, Articles 61, 111, 154, and 155 of the Contract Law, and Article 13 of the Supreme People's Court's Interpretation on Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Disputes over Commercial Housing Sales Contracts, on December 14, 2008, ruled:

1. The Defendant, Dongsheng Real Estate Company, shall, within 3 months from the effective date of this judgment, perform rectification and repair work on Room A, Building 10, Shui Jing Wan, located at the former XinDong South Road (now Hailing South Road), Dongtai City, which is owned by the Plaintiff, Yang Jun, in accordance with the correction and repair plan specified in the Appraisal Report No. SF207078-1 on the Causes and Repair Plan for Cracks in Room A, Building 10, Shui Jing Wan, Dongtai City, issued by Nanjing Southeast Construction Engineering Safety Appraisal Co., Ltd.;
2. All other claims of the Plaintiff, Yang Jun, are dismissed.

Dongsheng Real Estate Company, dissatisfied with the first-instance judgment, appealed to the Yancheng Intermediate People's Court of Jiangsu Province, with its main contentions as follows: The first-instance finding of facts was erroneous. The construction drawings and completion acceptance documents provided by the appellant could prove that the design and construction of the house in this case had passed the mandatory standard review by the relevant administrative department. The fact that no insulation layer was designed or installed on the roof of the appellee Yang Jun's house complied with the building standards and specifications in effect at the time. Therefore, the first-instance court's judgment ordering the appellant to repair the cracks and leakage of the house in accordance with the plan in the expert appraisal report lacked a sufficient basis. When the appellee purchased the commercial house, the appellant had already provided the corresponding drawings and materials as required by the relevant regulations. The parties explicitly agreed in the contract on the structure, floor, and other aspects of the house. When the house was completed and delivered, the appellant also provided the acceptance certificate, quality supervision report, and other documents as required by the relevant regulations. The appellee should have known the fact that no insulation layer was installed on the roof. Therefore, the first-instance judgment's determination that the appellant failed to fulfill its disclosure obligation when selling and delivering the house had no factual basis. The appellant requested the court of second instance to ascertain the facts, amend the judgment according to law, order the appellant only to undertake the repair obligation for the indoor cracks, and dismiss the appellee's other claims.

The Yancheng Intermediate People's Court, after the second-instance trial, confirmed the facts found in the first instance.

The Yancheng Intermediate People's Court held in the second-instance trial as follows:

The appellant, Dongsheng Real Estate Company, entered into a house sale contract with the appellee, Yang Jun. The appellant should guarantee that the house sold complied with the quality requirements prescribed by law or agreed in the contract. Now, the house delivered by the appellant to the appellee exhibited problems of wall cracks and leakage. According to an appraisal by a professional department, the main cause was the uneven shrinkage of structural materials due to temperature changes, and the fact that no insulation layer was installed on the roof and the poor quality of wall masonry led to obvious temperature cracks on the top floor. In this regard, as the seller of the house, the appellant should bear the corresponding repair obligation for the quality defects existing in the house it sold, according to law. The first-instance judgment was not improper.

Regarding the appellant Dongsheng Real Estate Company's argument that it should not bear corresponding liability because the delivered house had passed the mandatory standard review by the relevant administrative department and had passed the completion acceptance, the court held that although the house delivered by the appellant was reviewed and approved by the relevant administrative department from design and construction to completion, and the absence of an insulation layer on the roof complied with the building standards and specifications in effect at the time, the house delivered by the appellant to the appellee Yang Jun had obvious quality defects that had seriously affected the appellee's normal use of the house for habitation. The cause of these defects was also appraised by the relevant professional department. The fact that the house passed the standard review as argued by the appellant was only a determination made by the relevant administrative department, and it could not serve to negate the objective fact that the house had quality defects. Therefore, this ground of appeal of the appellant was not adopted.

The appellant Dongsheng Real Estate Company argued that it had provided the appellee Yang Jun with the relevant drawings and materials of the house, and the appellee should have known the fact that no insulation layer was installed on the roof. In this regard, this court held that the drawings and materials of the house are specialized technical materials. Without relevant disclosure by the appellant, the appellee could not have known, based on common sense alone, that no insulation layer was installed on the roof. Even if the appellee knew the fact that no insulation layer was installed, when the appellant delivered the house, the appellee could not have known that the absence of an insulation layer would cause problems such as cracking and leakage. Moreover, the quality defect of the house in this case was latent and was only discovered by the appellee during use. The appellant could not use the information advantage it possessed at the time of concluding the contract to exempt itself from the statutory duty to guarantee the quality of the house. Therefore, this ground of appeal of the appellant was not adopted.

Accordingly, the Yancheng Intermediate People's Court, in accordance with Article 153, Paragraph 1, Item (1) of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, rendered the following judgment on May 15, 2009:

The appeal is dismissed and the original judgment is affirmed.

This judgment is final.
